analogy.rationale: CDC42 is a Rho-family GTPase whose inhibition perturbs actin cytoskeletal dynamics and downstream kinase signaling; the closest reference classes are those targeting the same GTPase/cytoskeletal axis (CDC inhibitor, ROCK inhibitor) or proximal tyrosine kinase signaling, though transcriptional responses are likely modest and indirect.
